en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Finally, the elevator stopped and
the doors opened.

<CLT=cltMIND>And though I couldn't explain it,
my body stopped trembling.

Welcome! Go ahead and stand behind any
open podium!

Move your asses... You don't wanna see what
I'll do to you if you keep Father waiting.
Wait... Is he back to normal?
Huh? You not friend anymore?

You jerks must feel pretty slick, using
Monotaro's forgetfulness to befriend him...

He just decided on his own 
that we were friends...

But...I won't let you guys trick Monotaro
anymore, cuz he's already forgotten...

He may have forgotten that he was on
Daddy's side...

But now, he's forgotten that he had forgotten
that he was on Daddy's side!

...Thanks to me, cuz I smacked the stuffing
out of him!

Nyeeeh...how confusing.
Well, whatever.

I...can't remember, but...one of you guys
is the culprit, right?

I...I can't be in the same room as a killer...
It's dangerous...

I'm gonna go lock myself in my room!
Maybe even set up a barricade!
That's another death flag!

Let's get it started—the heart-racing excitement
as the blackened and the spotless face off!
<CLT=cltMIND>We went to our podiums, as always.

<CLT=cltMIND>We knew what we had to do.
There was no protest left in us.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's already the fourth time.

<CLT=cltMIND>The fourth class trial
was about to begin.
<CLT=cltMIND>Miu Iruma, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Inventor<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>She may have given us a lot of trouble...
but we all miss her.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a tragedy, after all.

<CLT=cltMIND>She helped me and Kaede with those
cameras, gave Keebo extra functions...

<CLT=cltMIND>In the end...she had done a
lot for us.
<CLT=cltMIND>And the culprit that killed her...
<CLT=cltMIND>is one of us.
<CLT=cltMIND>I need to discover who that is.

<CLT=cltMIND>In order to survive, I have to
find the culprit.
<CLT=cltMIND>...And I will fight for it.

<CLT=cltMIND>I will fight with truth and lies
in this class trial!
